cards.ex: The park is just a stone's throw from my apartment.
cards.exUz: Park mening kvartiramdan juda yaqin masofada joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin masofa, qo'l bilan otib yetkazsa bo'ladigan joy.

cards.ex: They decided to move in the suburbs for more space.
cards.exUz: Ular ko'proq joy uchun shahar chetiga ko'chib o'tishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning markazidan uzoqroq, aholi yashash joylari.

cards.ex: Urban sprawl is a major concern for environmentalists.
cards.exUz: Shahar kengayishi ekologlar uchun katta tashvish tug'dirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning tartibsiz va tez sur'atlar bilan kengayishi.

cards.ex: I love the energy of a bustling city.
cards.exUz: Men gavjum shaharning energiyasini yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar va harakatlar bilan to'la, hayot qaynayotgan shahar.

cards.ex: We're looking for a house in a leafy neighborhood.
cards.exUz: Biz yashil mahallada uy qidiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Daraxtlar ko'p bo'lgan, yam-yashil o'simliklarga ega mahalla.

cards.ex: It's easy to get around the city by public transport.
cards.exUz: Shaharda jamoat transportida harakatlanish oson.
cards.uzDef: Bir joydan ikkinchi joyga o'tmoq, sayohat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The view from the top of the high-rise building is amazing.
cards.exUz: Baland binoning tepasidan ko'rinish ajoyib.
cards.uzDef: Juda baland, ko'p qavatli bino.

cards.ex: They decided to rent out their spare room.
cards.exUz: Ular bo'sh xonalarini ijaraga berishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Pul evaziga biror narsadan foydalanishga ruxsat bermoq.

cards.ex: They're ready to settle down and start a family.
cards.exUz: Ular joylashib, oila qurishga tayyor.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy joylashuvga ega bo'lmoq, o'rnashib qolmoq.

cards.ex: I commute to work by train every day.
cards.exUz: Men har kuni poyezdda ishga qatnayman.
cards.uzDef: Uyidan ish joyiga muntazam borib kelmoq.

cards.ex: Property values have increased significantly in recent years.
cards.exUz: So'nggi yillarda mulk qiymati sezilarli darajada oshdi.
cards.uzDef: Uy, bino yoki yerning puldagi qiymati.

cards.ex: New York is a truly cosmopolitan city.
cards.exUz: Nyu-York chinakam kosmopolit shahar.
cards.uzDef: Turli millat va madaniyatlarga ega shahar.

cards.ex: It was a tight squeeze getting all the furniture into the apartment.
cards.exUz: Barcha mebellarni kvartiraga kiritish juda qiyin bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kichkina joyga zo'rg'a sig'adigan holat.

cards.ex: We bought a fixer-upper and plan to renovate it.
cards.exUz: Biz ta'mirga muhtoj uy sotib oldik va uni ta'mirlashni rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Ta'mirlashni talab qiladigan uy yoki bino.

cards.ex: The building looked run-down and abandoned.
cards.exUz: Bino qarovsiz va tashlandiq ko'rinardi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon holatda, ta'mirlashga muhtoj.

cards.ex: The area suffers from a lack of amenities like shops and restaurants.
cards.exUz: Hudud do'konlar va restoranlar kabi qulayliklarning yetishmasligidan aziyat chekmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qulayliklar, sharoitlar yetarli emasligi.

cards.ex: The inner city is often associated with poverty and crime.
cards.exUz: Shaharning markaziy qismi ko'pincha qashshoqlik va jinoyatchilik bilan bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning markaziy qismi, odatda eski va zich joylashgan.

cards.ex: That neighborhood is an up-and-coming area with lots of potential.
cards.exUz: Bu mahalla katta imkoniyatlarga ega rivojlanayotgan hudud.
cards.uzDef: Tez sur'atlar bilan yaxshilanayotgan va rivojlanayotgan hudud.

cards.ex: Many young people are being priced out of the housing market.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab yoshlar uy-joy bozorida narxlar balandligi sababli uy sotib ola olmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Narxlar yuqori bo'lgani sababli sotib ola olmaslik.

cards.ex: There's a strong sense of community in our village.
cards.exUz: Bizning qishlog'imizda kuchli jamoatchilik hissi bor.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda yashaydigan odamlar o'rtasidagi birlik va hamjihatlik tuyg'usi.

cards.ex: The housing market is very competitive right now.
cards.exUz: Hozirda uy-joy bozori juda raqobatbardosh.
cards.uzDef: Uylar va kvartiralarni sotib olish va sotish bozor.

cards.ex: We live on the outskirts of the city.
cards.exUz: Biz shaharning chetida yashaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning chekka qismida, markazdan uzoqda.

cards.ex: The beach is just a stone's throw away from our hotel.
cards.exUz: Plyaj bizning mehmonxonamizdan juda yaqin masofada joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin masofada joylashgan.

cards.ex: Los Angeles is a sprawling metropolis.
cards.exUz: Los-Anjeles - keng tarqalgan shahar.
cards.uzDef: Katta hududni egallagan va kengaygan shahar.

cards.ex: Let's hit the town tonight and celebrate!
cards.exUz: Keling, bugun kechqurun shaharga chiqib, bayram qilamiz!
cards.uzDef: Ko'ngil ochish uchun shaharga chiqmoq.

cards.ex: City dwellers often appreciate the convenience of public transport.
cards.exUz: Shahar aholisi ko'pincha jamoat transportining qulayligini qadrlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Shaharda yashovchi odam.

cards.ex: Good urban planning is essential for a sustainable city.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi shaharsozlik barqaror shahar uchun zarur.
cards.uzDef: Shaharlar va hududlarni rejalashtirish va rivojlantirish jarayoni.

cards.ex: It's hard to get on the property ladder these days.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi kunda mulk zinapoyasiga chiqish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Kichikroq va arzonroq mulkdan kattaroq va qimmatroq mulkka o'tish jarayoni.

cards.ex: We're planning to renovate the house next year.
cards.exUz: Biz kelgusi yilda uyni ta'mirlashni rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Uyning ichki yoki tashqi ko'rinishini yangilash, ta'mirlash.

cards.ex: The neighborhood watch helps to keep our community safe.
cards.exUz: Mahalla qo'riqlash bizning jamoamizni xavfsiz saqlashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatchilikka qarshi kurashish uchun mahalliy aholining tashkiloti.
